description: WCH CH224A USB PD3.0/3.1 sink protocol controller, 5-28 V request, ESSOP-10 with exposed baseplate, pin-compatible with CH224K. Source: CH224 manual 1 V2.1 (wch.cn), the same PDF as the showcase's C970725 (parts/C42459160_CH224_manual_V2.1.pdf); values from tables 4-1, 5-1, 5-2, 8.1.1, 8.2.1 and sections 5.2.1, 6.1.1, 7.1 which name CH224Q/CH224A explicitly.

pinout.name: GND
pinout.notes: Table 4-1 pin 0: common ground and heat-dissipating baseplate (exposed pad). The pulled footprint and symbol number it 11.

pinout.name: VHV
pinout.notes: Table 4-1: operating supply input, external 1 uF capacitor to GND (mind its voltage rating). 8.1.1 abs max 32.0 V; 8.2.1 operating 3.3-30 V, OVR reset 32-34 V. ICC 1.8 mA typ, 12 mA max.

pinout.name: CFG2/SCL
pinout.notes: Table 4-1 I,PU: internal pull-up 7-15 kOhm (8.2.1). May float in single-resistor mode (5.2.1). Abs max 6.5 V.

pinout.name: CFG3/SDA
pinout.notes: Table 4-1 I/O,PU: internal pull-up. May float in single-resistor mode (5.2.1). Abs max 6.5 V.

pinout.name: DP
pinout.notes: USB D+. Abs max 3.8 V. Unused here: the 6-pin receptacle has no D+/D- contacts.

pinout.name: DM
pinout.notes: USB D-. Abs max 3.8 V. Unused here.

pinout.name: CC2
pinout.notes: Type-C CC2, straight to receptacle B5; no external Rd in reference 6.1.1. Abs max 32 V.

pinout.name: CC1
pinout.notes: Type-C CC1, straight to receptacle A5. Abs max 32 V.

pinout.name: VBUS
pinout.notes: Table 4-1: voltage-detect input, must be shorted to VHV. Abs max 32 V.

pinout.name: CFG1
pinout.notes: Table 4-1: configuration input 1; single-resistor mode = Rset to GND (table 5-1). Abs max 3.8 V (7.1).

pinout.name: PG
pinout.notes: Power Good, open drain, active low; abs max 32 V (8.1.1). Sink current unpublished. Left unconnected.

decoupling.placement: VHV (pin 1) to GND, adjacent to the IC
decoupling.notes: The only capacitor the datasheet specifies (table 4-1, reference 6.1.1). Rated >= 50 V for a 20 V bus.

land_pattern.package: ESSOP10 150 mil, 1.00 mm pitch, exposed baseplate
land_pattern.notes: 9.1 gives the outline only (no land pattern): lead span 6.0, body 3.9 x 5.0, pitch 1.00. Pins 1-5 down one side, 6-10 up the other; baseplate = pin 0 (pad 11 in the pulled footprint).

layout_notes: REFERENCE CIRCUIT 6.1.1 (CH224A single-resistor mode): VBUS -> VHV (pin 1) with 1 uF to GND; VBUS pin 8 tied to VHV; CC1/CC2 direct to the receptacle; DP/DM to the receptacle data pins when present; Rset from CFG1 to GND; CFG2/CFG3 float when I2C is not used.
RSET TABLE 5-1 (CH224Q/CH224A): 6.8 kOhm = 9 V, 24 kOhm = 12 V, 56 kOhm = 15 V, 120 kOhm = 20 V, 210 kOhm = 28 V (28 V needs EPR + e-marked cable; not used).
I/O LEVEL TABLE 5-2 (CH224A differs from CH224K): 000 = 9 V, 001 = 12 V, 011 = 20 V, 010 = 28 V, 1XX = 5 V - no 15 V state, which is one reason this board uses Rset mode.
THERMAL: baseplate is the ground terminal - solder to GND copper with vias. PD max 300 mW (8.1.1); at 12 mA x 20 V = 240 mW worst case, typical 36 mW.
CC abs max 32 V on CH224A, so a CC-to-VBUS short in a damaged cable does not exceed the pin rating at 20 V.
5.3 eMarker emulation (1 k from CC2 to GND) applies only to a Type-C PLUG design; this board is a receptacle - do not fit it.
